stages.name: Change
stages.label: Change detection
stages.description: Multi-temporal land-cover changes observed across consecutive monitoring cycles (built-up, vegetation, water, bare land).

stages.name: Historical baseline
stages.label: Historical baseline
stages.description: Compares current change trajectory against the cell's multi-year historical growth trend (2020–2023).

stages.name: Local baseline
stages.label: Local baseline
stages.description: Compares change against the immediate neighborhood baseline to isolate localized deviation from regional trends.

stages.name: Anomaly
stages.label: Anomaly detection
stages.description: Identifies statistically significant temporal and spatial divergence, confirming multi-temporal persistence.

stages.name: Evidence
stages.label: Evidence dossier
stages.description: Compiles verifiable observation records, acquisition dates, deltas, and percentile ranks into an inspectable dossier.

stages.name: Priority
stages.label: Priority score
stages.description: Translates compound factor contributions into an explainable ranking score without manual or arbitrary overrides.

stages.name: Investigation list
stages.label: Investigation list
stages.description: Delivers an actionable, ordered queue of highest-urgency sites for municipal field inspection deployment.
